title: Investigating Mobile Users' Ringer Mode Usage and Attentiveness and Responsiveness to Communication

scope_decision.qualification: The Android logger uses Accessibility events, ringer-mode changes, communication/notification actions, and event-triggered context snapshots to derive attentiveness, SMS conversation, and ringer-state interval measures. This is not merely a survey about phone preferences.

source_artifacts.identity_verification: Author-hosted proceedings-layout PDF prints the title, authors, MobileHCI 2015 venue and DOI 10.1145/2785830.2785852 on p. 6; printed pp. 6–15 inspected. Byte equivalence to publisher VOR is unverified.

disclosed_atoms.mapping: Study cohort and version boundary; not a universal Android collector rule.

disclosed_atoms.value: Android Accessibility Service observes clicking, typing, swiping, notification viewing, and other user events in app context.
disclosed_atoms.locator: PDF pp. 7–8 The Android Logger App
disclosed_atoms.mapping: UI action records, not UsageStats foreground events; exact callback constants and export columns are not published.

value: phone/VOIP/video call initiation, receipt and ending
disclosed_atoms.locator: PDF pp. 7–8 The Android Logger App
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Different source event families; no one-to-one notification/reading inference.

disclosed_atoms.value: Top Android Market communication apps were surveyed and participants named the communication apps they used; these informed the monitored app list.
disclosed_atoms.locator: PDF p. 7 The Android Logger App
disclosed_atoms.mapping: The complete app list and versioned matching algorithm are not reported.

disclosed_atoms.value: A context snapshot is captured only on a targeted event, rather than by continuous tracking, to limit power use.
disclosed_atoms.locator: PDF p. 8 The Android Logger App
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Event-triggered snapshot acquisition is distinct from periodic sampling or post-hoc event filtering.

disclosed_atoms.locator: PDF p. 8 The Android Logger App
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Snapshot components have distinct provenance; exact capture latency, schema and missingness are not given.

disclosed_atoms.locator: PDF p. 8 The Android Logger App
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Google activity-recognition categories are context values, not ringer modes.

disclosed_atoms.value: End-of-day questions refer to logged events in the previous 24 hours, including ringer changes, missed calls, and unread-notification intervals over one hour.
disclosed_atoms.locator: PDF p. 8 The Android Logger App / Fig. 1
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Retrospective event-indexed diary, not immediate event-contingent ESM; exact event selection/random seed unknown.

disclosed_atoms.locator: PDF p. 8 The Android Logger App
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Sampling cap and display order are separate from acquisition or analysis inclusion.

disclosed_atoms.locator: PDF p. 8 The Android Logger App
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Prompt schedule, not event-log cadence.

disclosed_atoms.value: Attentiveness and responsiveness analyses used SMS rather than MMA; cross-device MMA replies could be missing from the phone log.
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Analysis selection due to observability limit; do not delete collected MMA records or claim SMS has no cross-device issues.

disclosed_atoms.value: Group SMS with the same contact within six minutes into a conversation; distinguish new incoming messages from chat messages by whether an exchange preceded them within six minutes.
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Keyed communication-thread construction, not app-session inactivity; exact equality, tie, participant and orphan rules are unreported.

value: opening notification bar or selecting a notification
composing outgoing in the same communication app
disclosed_atoms.mapping: These are proxies for attention, not direct observation of reading individual message content.

disclosed_atoms.value: Intervals between user-initiated attending actions estimate general attentiveness.
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Inter-action measure; timestamp ties, coverage boundaries and censoring unreported.

disclosed_atoms.value: Interval from incoming-SMS notification to the first later attending action measures SMS-specific attentiveness.
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Attribution of a subsequent action to an alert is a proxy, not proof that this SMS was read.
Ordinal analysis bins, distinct from the six-minute conversation grouping; boundary inclusion for the middle bin is not fully specified.

disclosed_atoms.value: An incoming SMS is marked responded to if an outgoing SMS to the same contact is observed.
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Response is separate from inferred attention; exact matching horizon and multiple-message allocation are not fully specified.

disclosed_atoms.value: A ringer-mode session spans time using one mode until switching to another; observed states are Normal, Vibrate and Silent.
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Candidate target is setting-state occupancy, not app/session use. Initial, terminal and power-off boundaries are unreported.

disclosed_atoms.value: For each ringer-mode session, calculate the average interval between attending actions within the session.
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Ringer-state interval is the aggregation scope; method for intervals crossing boundaries or sessions with fewer than two actions is unknown.

disclosed_atoms.value: Per-participant duration in each mode could not be reliably estimated because the duration of phone-off periods was unknown.
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Reported inability to estimate per-participant time-in-mode reliably; not a disclosed no-bridge algorithm, event filter or interval-construction rule.

disclosed_atoms.value: Attentiveness bins used mixed-effect ordinal logistic regression; SMS responsiveness used mixed-effect logistic regression, with ringer mode and locale as independent variables and between-subject random effect.
disclosed_atoms.mapping: Downstream statistical models, not alternative Android event constructors.

source_operation_partial_order: Observe Accessibility/communication/ringer/wake/notification events and take target-event context snapshots; deliver a separately scheduled prior-day diary.
Restrict attentiveness/response analysis to SMS because the phone-only MMA reply stream is incomplete.
Construct same-contact SMS conversations, attention proxies and first-subsequent-action latencies; keep response as a separate same-contact outcome.

Construct ringer-mode occupancy intervals on observed switches and aggregate attending-action gaps inside them. The separately reported inability to estimate per-participant time-in-mode does not disclose a power-off processing rule.
indispensable_unavailable_facts: No source-shaped logger export, callback constants, app-selection list or executable study collector was identified for this bounded audit.

The paper does not resolve six-minute equality, tie and multi-message matching, snapshot capture latency, ringer initial/terminal and power-off boundaries, or intervals with fewer than two attending actions.

semantic_residues_vs_current_linkml.source_case: Ringer-mode state occupancy until a switch, with action-gap aggregation scoped inside each interval and unobservable powered-off time.
semantic_residues_vs_current_linkml.existing_terms: MethodSettingAssertion and SessionConstructionPolicy can preserve prose. The new device_setting_state_interval target distinguishes ringer-setting occupancy from app, screen and device-use sessions in method assertions.
semantic_residues_vs_current_linkml.residue: A source-located parser and save–reload test failed before this target was added and now passes with literal values and locators. That proves the method target distinction only; no source-shaped ringer row, interval constructor, power-off rule or native execution has been demonstrated. Do not recast this as UsageSessionAssertion (unlock-to-lock).

completion_verdict: Bounded exact-source candidate extraction, not canonical admission or whole-paper replication. The ringer-state interval method target now passes a source-located parser and save–reload round-trip; a source-row import, interval constructor and full-paper semantic round-trip remain unproved.
